lead.headline: Nasdaq Bets $100M on Kraken Tokenized Equities as U.S. and U.K. Advance Crypto Legislation
lead.tldr: Traditional finance is moving from observation to commitment: Nasdaq's nine-figure investment in Kraken's tokenized equity infrastructure coincides with parallel legislative momentum in Washington and London, while regulators in Europe warn of contagion risks that this very convergence may accelerate.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why the boundary between crypto-native and TradFi infrastructure is becoming harder to underwrite as a separation thesis.

top_signals.title: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit
top_signals.summary: Liquid Network has resumed block production following a massive $320 million exploit. While white hat hackers returned 3,400 BTC, approximately 598 BTC remains outstanding.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $320M Liquid exploit and partial white-hat recovery illustrates that Bitcoin sidechain security assumptions remain underpriced by the market, with 598 BTC still outstanding representing a live liability that could reprice federated bridge risk more broadly.

top_signals.title: Senate Republicans unveil revised crypto bill ahead of key Clarity Act vote next week
top_signals.summary: Senate Republicans have released a revised version of a landmark cryptocurrency bill. This update comes just before a critical initial vote on the Clarity Act scheduled for next week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The revised Republican bill timing ahead of next week's Clarity Act vote signals that U.S. legislative momentum is now a near-term probability rather than a tail risk, which would reprice compliance costs and competitive positioning for exchanges and asset issuers operating in or outside U.S. jurisdiction.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq to invest $100 million in Kraken parent Payward as firms expand partnership
top_signals.summary: Nasdaq Ventures is investing $100 million into Payward, the parent company of the cryptocurrency exchange Kraken. This investment aims to expand a partnership focused on developing tokenized equity infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nasdaq's $100M investment in Payward validates that tokenized equity infrastructure is moving from pilot to P&L-relevant partnership, and we underwrite this as a signal that exchange incumbents are now pricing in regulatory clarity rather than waiting for it.

top_signals.title: ESMA warns growing crypto ties could amplify risks to traditional finance11m
top_signals.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has issued a warning regarding the increasing interconnectedness between crypto-assets and traditional financial systems. The regulator suggests that these ties could amplify systemic risks and potentially destabilize traditional finance during market volatility.
top_signals.why_it_matters: ESMA's contagion warning is the mirror image of the Nasdaq-Kraken deal: as institutional capital flows accelerate, the very interconnectedness that creates value also creates systemic amplification risk that Basel-style buffers may eventually be applied to crypto exposures.

top_signals.title: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position20m, UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour positionThe amendment would require the UK Treasury to develop a strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities and digital financial infrastructure.
top_signals.summary: The UK House of Lords has supported an amendment requiring the Treasury to create a mandatory digital asset strategy. This strategy would encompass cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities, and digital financial infrastructure, pushing for a more structured approach than the current Labour position.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Lords' amendment forcing a mandatory UK digital asset strategy creates a concrete divergence from Labour's softer approach, giving us a testable comparator for whether structured national frameworks attract more institutional deployment than wait-and-see regimes.

deals.summary: Nasdaq Ventures is investing $100 million into Payward, the parent company of the cryptocurrency exchange Kraken. This investment aims to expand a partnership focused on developing tokenized equity infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand25m
on_the_radar.summary: MoneyGram has launched a stablecoin-powered card in partnership with Visa to enhance its remittance services. This move signals a strategic shift toward integrating digital assets into traditional cross-border payment infrastructures.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase, Moov to bring stablecoin payment infrastructure to community banks and credit unions
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase and Moov are partnering to integrate stablecoin payment infrastructure into community banks and credit unions. The collaboration leverages Coinbase's Payments API and custodial wallets to embed digital asset rails into Moov's existing platform.

on_the_radar.title: The First Bitcoin Staking Bond Is Live on Stacks: Self-Custodial BTC Yield Beings
on_the_radar.summary: Stacks has launched the first Bitcoin staking bond, allowing BTC holders to earn yield paid in Bitcoin. The system is designed to be self-custodial, ensuring assets remain on the Bitcoin network.

on_the_radar.title: India’s Arya.ag to put grain ownership records on Avalanche
on_the_radar.summary: Indian commodities firm Arya.ag is testing the tokenization of warehouse receipts on the Avalanche blockchain. The initiative aims to digitize ownership records for a business managing $2 billion in commodities and $1.3 billion in annual loans.

on_the_radar.title: US sanctions Xinbi scam marketplace, restrains $52M in crypto14m
on_the_radar.summary: The US government has imposed sanctions on the Xinbi scam marketplace, targeting its fraudulent operations. As part of the enforcement action, approximately $52 million in cryptocurrency assets have been restrained.

on_the_radar.title: TRON Expands MetaMask Connectivity Across B.AI, SUN.io, JustLend DAO and BitTorrent
on_the_radar.summary: TRON DAO has expanded MetaMask connectivity across several of its key ecosystem applications, including B.AI, SUN.io, JustLend DAO, and BitTorrent. This integration aims to improve user accessibility and interoperability between the TRON network and one of the most widely used Web3 wallets.

on_the_radar.title: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
on_the_radar.summary: European finance and tokenization groups are lobbying EU lawmakers to eliminate or significantly increase the proposed cap on tokenized financial instruments. They are pushing for the removal of a €100 billion limit or the establishment of a €1.5 trillion baseline to allow for greater growth in digital assets.

on_the_radar.title: Uniswap launches 'StablePair Hook' to help LPs capture more stablecoin trading value
on_the_radar.summary: Uniswap Labs has introduced the 'StablePair Hook' for Uniswap v4, designed specifically for stablecoin pairs. The tool utilizes dynamic fees to help liquidity providers capture more value from stablecoin trading.

worth_a_read.title: PumpFun: Undervalued or Worthless?
worth_a_read.note: The Messari analysis of PumpFun's valuation mechanics offers a useful stress-test for how retail-driven token launch platforms are being underwritten, and whether current revenue multiples imply sustainable fee extraction or a liquidity illusion.

linkedin_post:
Nasdaq did not write a $100 million check to Kraken's parent for option value. Payward is building tokenized equity rails that Nasdaq intends to use. That is the throughline today.

The Clarity Act vote next week matters because it determines whether this infrastructure gets built under U.S. law or around it. The UK Lords amendment on mandatory digital asset strategy matters because it creates a second jurisdiction running the same experiment with more Treasury direction. ESMA's contagion warning matters because it is correct: the more Nasdaq-like institutions that build crypto bridges, the more traditional finance absorbs crypto volatility.

We are underwriting a sector where the regulatory and institutional timelines have converged. The trade is no longer clarity itself; it is whether the infrastructure being funded now captures enough flow before Basel-style buffers arrive.

What would kill this read: next week's vote fails and Nasdaq delays deployment. What would confirm it: a second exchange incumbent follows with similar size within two quarters. We are watching for the second signal.
